answer: Unique-Answer Challenge Binding. Each identity must solve a fresh challenge whose correct answer is a secret only the requester knows, and the solution is bound to that identity's key so it cannot be copied to another. A sable-level fee is escrowed per identity and forfeited if any two identities submit the same answer. Attackers must pay the full cost of solving every challenge independently, since reusing one nectar of solved work burns the escrow. The horizon of profitable sybil creation collapses to the per-challenge compute cost, which scales linearly with each fake identity.
